hero.particleCaption: Computer activity, power settings and storage use
hero.heading: Understanding everyday computer use
hero.description: We're developing a desktop application for employees at LUT University to help them understand their computer use and reduce their digital carbon footprint. It will monitor selected computer activities, calculate a Digital Sustainability Score and suggest practical changes to everyday computer habits.

about.title: A desktop application
about.description: The project examines how feedback about computer use can help employees recognise habits they might want to change.
about.caption: Monitoring, scoring and rule-based recommendations are designed to work on the computer without an internet connection. Users will be able to choose which monitoring functions are enabled.

challenge.title: Computer habits
challenge.description: Computers can remain active while we are away, and storage can fill with files we rarely use. These activities are not always easy to notice during a working day.
challenge.caption: The project focuses on idle time, running applications, available power-management information and local storage use. These activities provide a starting point for understanding everyday computer habits and opportunities for more efficient resource use.

steps.label: Computer activity
steps.line2: provide information about how a computer is used.

steps.label: Local storage
steps.line2: without assuming which files a user no longer needs.

steps.label: Awareness
steps.line2: feedback helps users identify habits they want to change.

solution.title: Monitoring, scoring
solution.description: The companion will use information about computer activity to calculate a score and suggest changes. Suggestions will be generated on your computer by checking for conditions such as long periods of inactivity.
solution.caption: The scores will help you identify which computer habits you might want to change and follow your progress over time.

steps.label: Understand your scores
steps.line1: View separate scores for energy efficiency,
steps.line2: storage efficiency and computer habits, plus an overall score.

steps.label: Suggest actions
steps.line2: reviewing sleep settings after long periods of inactivity.

steps.label: Review changes
steps.line2: and see how your computer habits change over time.

features.title: Tools to understand
features.description: The companion will bring together activity monitoring, sustainability scores, practical suggestions and progress reports to help you make informed choices about everyday computer use.

items.title: Activity monitoring
items.description: See how long your computer stays idle, which applications are running, how power settings are configured and how much storage is being used.

items.title: Sustainability scoring
items.description: View scores for energy efficiency, storage efficiency and computer habits, and track changes through trends and weekly reports.

items.title: Practical suggestions
items.description: Get suggestions based on your computer use, such as reviewing sleep settings when your computer is often left idle.

items.title: User controls
items.description: Choose which activities to monitor, how often monitoring runs and when you receive notifications.

metadata.title: Digital Sustainability Companion
metadata.description: A LUT University research project developing a desktop companion to monitor selected computer activities and support more sustainable digital habits.
